current_goal: Independently cross-check the exact HZT-M0-S6-C1 anchor and its discrete forward-mode-AD Jacobian with a second integration and sensitivity backend, then define one governed continuation parameter and derive the implicit-function tangent before any nonlinear corrector or root solve is considered.

verified_results.statement: The C1 reference scale mu6=(kappa6_sq)^(-1/4), the complete dimensionless variable map, the dimensionless radial equations and fixed positive residual scales are derived and pre-registered for diagnostic use.

C1 admits an exact analytic background with A=0, ell=sin(x), varphi=0, opposite half-unit magnetic charges, two regular gauge patches and a common cap at x=pi/2; all eight continuum cap residuals vanish exactly.

Forward-mode automatic differentiation through the complete fixed-step RK4 IVP-to-normalized-residual map yields rank eight at the exact C1 anchor, sigma_min=0.0695893845582763 and condition number 221.95557616755255 at 800 steps per region.

The relative Frobenius change of the discrete Jacobian between 400 and 800 RK4 steps is 2.863079188994937e-12, while the maximum normalized anchor residual decreases from 1.5936623892532058e-09 at 100 steps to 3.899701742082573e-13 at 800 steps.
On the analytic scalar-shift surface m2=0 and lambda1=0, the same AD pipeline reproduces rank seven with one exact null singular direction.

For the minimal HZT-M0-S6 Einstein-Hilbert sector, the formal relation M4_bulk_squared=V_W/kappa6_squared remains DERIVED_CONDITIONAL; the historical numerical V_W normalization remains unresolved and is not replaced by the C1 anchor.

open_blockers.statement: The exact anchor and rank-eight discrete Jacobian have not yet been cross-checked by an independent integration and sensitivity backend.
No governed continuation parameter, parameter derivative, implicit-function tangent or nonlinear continuation family has been constructed.
Step-converged full rank of the discrete map is not an analytic proof of the continuum BVP Jacobian rank, existence or uniqueness away from the exact anchor.
No adaptive root corrector, independent solver backend, branch tracking, turning-point test or basin-of-attraction study exists; official solver execution remains unauthorized.
Scalar-vector-tensor perturbations, kinetic positivity, gradient stability and ghost freedom remain uncomputed for C1.
C1 remains a newly defined candidate and is not identified with the missing historical A0 action, solver or benchmark normalization.

active_assumptions: HZT-M0-S6-C1 is a new candidate branch and not a historical reconstruction.
The exact analytic anchor is a unit two-sphere represented by two smooth disk regions and two regular gauge patches.
The eight residual scales are fixed before differentiation and do not depend on the evaluated solution.
The reported Jacobian is the exact forward-mode derivative of the declared fixed-step RK4 computational map, not an analytic continuum operator theorem.
The rr equations remain propagated QA channels rather than additional endpoint residuals.
No root finding or nonlinear continuation has been authorized.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer continuum Jacobian rank from the discrete AD rank alone.
Do not infer a nontrivial solution family, uniqueness or a finite basin of attraction from one exact anchor.
Do not identify the C1 anchor with the historical A0 model or its benchmarks.
Do not treat step convergence or moderate conditioning as perturbative stability or ghost freedom.
Do not implement or run an official root solver before the independent-backend and continuation contracts are governed.
Do not change K1-D or K1-E without the governed release chain.
next_exact_action: Implement a second independent, non-RK4 integration and sensitivity backend for the exact C1 anchor; compare residuals and Jacobians under pre-registered tolerances; then select one explicit continuation parameter and compute the linear implicit-function tangent dX/dp=-J^{-1}R_p without executing a nonlinear corrector or official root solve.
